title: Context-read ordering follow-up
summary: Relax in-session context-read ordering so parent/task reads can be reused without sequence errors
description:
Follow-up to the cross-harness context-read reuse work in F020. Current source shows the real repeated CONTEXT_READ_REQUIRED issue is not MCP session identity instability; it is the strict in-session ordering check inside `packages/plan-core/src/read-tracking.ts`, where `contextReadEligibilityForSession()` treats parent reads as invalid when they happen before the task read and reports them as effectively unusable until reread in task → phase → feature order.

Actual implementation scope for this phase:
- Relax `contextReadEligibilityForSession()` in `packages/plan-core/src/read-tracking.ts` so any in-memory read recorded in the current harness session satisfies eligibility regardless of sequence order, while persisted attestations still enforce freshness via entity revisions.
- Remove the obsolete `out-of-order` state from the machine-readable `RequiredContextRead` contract and keep diagnostics limited to the meaningful states `missing` and `stale`.
- Add regression coverage in `packages/plan-core/test/read-tracking.test.mjs` for reversed parent-first reads and in `packages/plan-mcp/test/mcp-crud.test.mjs` for a real MCP task_start flow that reads requirements/feature/phase/task in non-legacy order and still starts successfully.
- Align the shared planner operational guidance in `plugins/_shared/planner-skill.md.in` and any harness-facing generated guidance so agents are told to follow only the missing/stale `nextActions`, with reads allowed in any order inside the current session.

Non-goals for this phase:
- No RequestHandlerExtra session-id threading overhaul in `packages/plan-mcp/src/index.ts`; that was already addressed by the earlier F020 session-aware work.
- No unrelated UI work or priority-surface changes here; those belong to a separate improvement phase.

Acceptance:
- Focused core + MCP regressions cover the orderless in-session read behavior.
- Full repository verification passes after the guidance/source updates.

tasks.title: Fix MCP plannerSessionId instability causing repeated CONTEXT_READ_REQUIRED
tasks.description:
Fix repeated CONTEXT_READ_REQUIRED in MCP caused by strict task→phase→feature read ordering in contextReadEligibilityForSession (packages/plan-core/src/read-tracking.ts). Agents got "out-of-order" errors when reading parents before tasks, even after completing the reads.

Three-part fix:

**Part 1: Relax ordering (DONE)**
- Relaxed contextReadEligibilityForSession so in-memory reads satisfy eligibility regardless of sequence order
- Removed "out-of-order" state from RequiredContextRead type
- Added regression tests in read-tracking.test.mjs and mcp-crud.test.mjs

**Part 2: Surface priority in list views (TODO)**
Add priority values to list/discovery outputs so agents can follow priority ordering when browsing manually:
- `planner-task-list` (MCP): add priority field to structured content
- `planner-phase-list` (MCP): add priority field to structured content
- `planner-feature-list` (MCP): add priority field to structured content
- `task_list` (Pi): include priority in text output
- `phase_list` (Pi): include priority in text output
- `feature_list` (Pi): include priority in text output
- Web UI task-row.tsx: show priority badge using formatPriority
- Web UI work-tree-rows.tsx: show priority in task rows

**Part 3: Extend skill guidance (TODO)**
- Update planner-skill.md.in with priority-following instructions
- Add priority guidance to Pi adapter /planner operational protocol
- Ensure skill is auto-read on load

Acceptance: node scripts/test-all.mjs unit --no-build reports fail 0; priority visible in list outputs

---
**Completion summary:**
Corrected the planner metadata to reflect the real root cause and completed the code-level follow-up for orderless in-session read reuse. Source changes now keep `packages/plan-core/src/read-tracking.ts` relaxed to accept current-session task/phase/feature reads in any order while still reporting only meaningful `missing`/`stale` requirements; aligned retry guidance in `plugins/_shared/planner-skill.md.in`, `packages/agent-plan/src/index.ts`, and Pi’s injected operational context text in `packages/pi-adapter/src/index.ts`; regenerated the shared Claude planner skill via `node scripts/sync-plugins.cjs`; and verified the behavior with focused builds/tests: `pnpm --filter @agent-plan/core build`, `pnpm --filter @agent-plan/mcp build`, `pnpm --filter @agent-plan/pi-adapter build`, `pnpm --filter agent-plan build`, and `node --test packages/plan-core/test/read-tracking.test.mjs packages/plan-mcp/test/mcp-crud.test.mjs packages/agent-plan/test/version.test.mjs packages/pi-adapter/test/web-lifecycle.test.mjs` (39/39 passing). Remaining work moved out of this task: priority visibility is now tracked separately in P085(F005)/T347.
